newsitem.title: USA: Intellicall doesn't see Q3 better than Q2.
newsitem.headline: Intellicall doesn't see Q3 better than Q2.

text.p: Intellicall Inc said Friday that it does not expect its third quarter to show an improvement over its second quarter results.
The company reported a loss of $0.10 per share for the second quarter and a $0.13 per share loss in the first quarter.
First Call estimates for the third quarter were unavailable.
The company made the statement after announcing that it will begin providing a comprehensive prepaid calling card program to Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc.

The company said it expects revenues in the first year of the contract to exceed $1.5 million but said the contract will not affect third quarter net income, "which is not expected to show improvement from the second quarter of 1996."
